mapper.select:
select u.U_Name as pcnUserName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId,
from Pre_ProjectChangeName pcn left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=pcn.PCN_User_ID left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=pcn.PCN_ID where pcn.PCN_Id=#{pcnId}
mapper.sql: pcn.PCN_ID as pcnId, pcn.P_ID as pId, pcn.PCN_Old_Name as pcnOldName, pcn.PCN_New_Name as pcnNewName, pcn.PCN_User_ID as pcnUserId, pcn.PCN_Create_Time as pcnCreateTime, pcn.PCN_Modify_Reason as pcnModifyReason, pcn.PCN_Attachment as pcnAttachment, pcn.PCN_Create_Uid as pcnCreateUid, pcn.PCN_Create_Uname as pcnCreateUname, pcn.PCN_FlowState as pcnFlowstate, pcn.PCN_FlowDate as pcnFlowdate
